title: Effects of transportation stress and addition of salt to transport water on the skin mucosal homeostasis of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss)
adjudication_rationale: Transport, physiological responses and stress are substantive. V3_114 is excluded because skin is the system in which physiological and mucosal responses are measured rather than an anatomical or histological research question.

title: Gene expression in Atlantic salmon skin in response to infection with the parasitic copepod Lepeophtheirus salmonis, cortisol implant, and their combination
adjudication_rationale: Cortisol is independently manipulated and produces substantive molecular, metabolic, immune and wound-healing responses beyond the specific host response to sea lice.

title: Public resources for private mariculture: Northeastern United States Atlantic Canada and Scotland after NAFTA and GATT
adjudication_rationale: Sector innovation, financing, government policy and international trade policy are substantive. NAFTA, GATT and the removal of tariffs and trade barriers form part of the explanatory framework.
